thread:
Sam G.: heads-up — we're seeing a sharp traffic spike to the embeddings store in us-east. Elevated tail latency + some 5xxs for realtime embeddings. Opening incident and posting status: https://status.redwood.inference/incident/1943201110
SRE-Bot: ALERT: embed-store::queue_depth > 75% (60s) | p99 latency 6.2s | errors 11.8% | affected: hosted-embeddings, some dedicated-pools
Maria K.: oncall here, investigating. Initial hypothesis: KV cache saturation + embed-store read queue buildup after a client-side retry loop kicked in around 12:03 UTC.
Dave H.: mitigation plan: temporarily scale read replicas + enable overflow shards. Also toggling cache-bypass for very large batched requests. Doing a rollback of the routing change from today as a precaution.
Lena C.: running scale now — replicas 4 -> 8. Enabled cache_bypass flag for requests > 50 embeddings. Rolling rollback of routing-v2 started (canary -> full if green).
Maria K.: metrics post-mitigation (12:12 UTC): errors down to ~3.4% (from 11.8%), p99 latency -> 2.0s (from 6.2s). queue_depth trending down. Still seeing occasional spikes.
Product Ops: customer impact note: customers using realtime suggestions/embeddings may have seen elevated latency or 5xx between 12:03–12:10 UTC. We'll prepare a short banner and targeted emails for accounts >1% error rate.
Sam G.: current status: degraded -> recovering. Next steps: monitor for 20m, validate no regression in routing rollback, verify dedicated pools are stable. If p95 or errors rise again, revert routing rollback and re-run canary with instrumentation.
Dave H.: pushed canary fix for routing fallback. Rolling 20% -> 100% if green. Commands used: ```kubectl -n embed scale statefulset/embed-store --replicas=8; ./scripts/toggle-feature cache_bypass true```
Maria K.: can someone own comms? Need severity (we think SEV-2) and exact impacted window to publish on status page. Also please pin the runbook link in this thread.
Product Ops: will draft banner now and update status page with SEV-2 and impacted window 12:03–12:10 UTC. Postmortem doc placeholder: https://redwood-internal/docs/incidents/1943201110. Thanks everyone — will post another update in 15m :thumbsup:
Sam G.: ack, monitoring. please add any logs or red flags here.
